lines.zh: 我的脚步震得碎石往上跳
lines.en: My steps make loose stones jump off the ground.

lines.zh: 这条道是踩出来的，不是挖的
lines.en: This path was trampled out, not dug.

lines.zh: 五百点生命，走起来很沉
lines.en: Five hundred health makes for heavy walking.

lines.zh: 我绕着圈走，把地压平
lines.en: I walk in circles and flatten the ground.

lines.zh: 前面的树太细，挡不住我
lines.en: Those trees are too thin to stop me.

lines.zh: 我一步一步挪，地都在抖
lines.en: I shift one step at a time and the ground shakes.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫过的地方，草倒了
lines.en: Where my tail sweeps, the grass lies flat.

lines.zh: 胃口空着，走路就没劲
lines.en: With an empty appetite, my steps lose force.

lines.zh: 这条沟我走过很多次了
lines.en: I've walked this gully many times before.

lines.zh: 每走一步，我都往四下看
lines.en: With every step, I scan all around me.

lines.zh: 我的胃口条在头顶晃
lines.en: My appetite bar wavers above your head.

lines.zh: 上一次吃饱，是很久以前
lines.en: My last full meal was a long time ago.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔牙，牙缝里还有骨渣
lines.en: I lick my teeth; bits of bone remain between.

lines.zh: 这身甲片是老的，磨得发亮
lines.en: These old plates are worn smooth and bright.

lines.zh: 上古时候，我吃的是更大的东西
lines.en: In ancient days I fed on far larger creatures.

lines.zh: 我在闻，风里有血有铁
lines.en: I sniff; the wind carries blood and iron.

lines.zh: 肚子叫起来像闷雷
lines.en: My stomach growls like distant thunder.

lines.zh: 我蹲下来，影子罩住半个坡
lines.en: I crouch and my shadow covers half the slope.

lines.zh: 只要吃饱，我就懒得动
lines.en: When I'm fed, I can't be bothered to move.

lines.zh: 那块岩石像一块肉，可惜不是
lines.en: That boulder looks like meat, but it isn't.

lines.zh: 我把地面刨开，下面有根
lines.en: I claw the ground open and find roots.

lines.zh: 我记得每一顿吃的是什么
lines.en: I remember what I ate at every meal.

lines.zh: 我的食欲每天都涨一点
lines.en: My appetite grows a little each day.

lines.zh: 他们在远处搭营，我不在意
lines.en: They're setting camp far off; I don't care.

lines.zh: 我把身子挪到阴影里，凉快些
lines.en: I shift into the shade; it is cooler there.

lines.zh: 我在回味上一顿，连骨头都嚼了
lines.en: I chew over the last meal, bones and all.

lines.zh: 你站在那儿，闻起来能吃
lines.en: You stand there smelling edible to me.

lines.zh: 你的个头，一口都不到
lines.en: You're not even a mouthful at your size.

lines.zh: 别动，我在算你有多重
lines.en: Stay still; I'm estimating your weight.

lines.zh: 我认得这种眼神，是害怕
lines.en: I know that look, that's fear.

lines.zh: 你带来的东西，是给我吃的吗
lines.en: Is what you brought meant for me to eat?

lines.zh: 你的护甲声音很脆
lines.en: Your armor makes a brittle sound.

lines.zh: 我看你，是在看一顿饭
lines.en: I look at you and see a meal.

lines.zh: 你不跑，倒是少见
lines.en: You aren't running; that's rare.

lines.zh: 我微微低头，是给你留面子
lines.en: I lower my head a little to spare your pride.

lines.zh: 你手里的肉，先扔过来
lines.en: Toss that meat over first.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在夜里不亮，但看得清
lines.en: My eyes don't glow, but they see in the dark.

lines.zh: 你挡着我的路了
lines.en: You're standing in my path.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，不是打哈欠
lines.en: My mouth is open, and it isn't a yawn.

lines.zh: 你数得清我的牙吗
lines.en: Can you count all my teeth?

lines.zh: 你的膝盖在响，我听得见
lines.en: Your knees creak; I can hear it.

lines.zh: 你握斧头的手攥得太白了
lines.en: The hand on your axe is clenched white.

lines.zh: 你这一下，只够掉一层皮
lines.en: That blow barely took a layer of hide.

lines.zh: 疼让我更饿，你知道吗
lines.en: Pain makes me hungrier, do you know that?

lines.zh: 甲片碎了，但骨头没事
lines.en: A plate cracked, but the bone held.

lines.zh: 我要停一会儿，你等着
lines.en: I'll pause a moment; wait for me.

lines.zh: 四分之一，我记着这个数
lines.en: One quarter gone; I'm keeping count.

lines.zh: 你的武器在我身上留不下痕
lines.en: Your weapon leaves hardly a mark on me.

lines.zh: 我往后坐了一格，稳住了
lines.en: I settle back one block and steady myself.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我的旧伤上
lines.en: That struck an old wound of mine.

lines.zh: 我发出一声低吼，不是求饶
lines.en: I let out a low roar; it isn't a plea.

lines.zh: 再来几下，我就动真格
lines.en: A few more hits and I stop holding back.

lines.zh: 这个标签上的东西，我都吃
lines.en: Everything on that tag list, I eat.

lines.zh: 把食物扔在我面前，快点
lines.en: Toss the food right in front of me.

lines.zh: 只要够多，我就不挑
lines.en: As long as it's plenty, I'm not picky.

lines.zh: 你带着一整只，我闻到了
lines.en: You're carrying a whole one; I can smell it.

lines.zh: 小份的不算，别来糊弄
lines.en: Small portions don't count; don't insult me.

lines.zh: 我饿了，什么都能咽下去
lines.en: I'm hungry enough to swallow anything.

lines.zh: 你退后，我才吃
lines.en: Back away, and then I'll eat.

lines.zh: 那篮东西归我了
lines.en: That basket of food is mine.

lines.zh: 吃完再谈别的
lines.en: We'll discuss other things after I eat.

lines.zh: 味道不够冲，我不太满意
lines.en: The smell is too weak; I'm not impressed.

lines.zh: 撞到我腿上，你像块石头
lines.en: You hit my leg like a pebble.

lines.zh: 我挪一下身子，你就退三步
lines.en: I shift my body and you take three steps back.

lines.zh: 你撞的是甲片，不是皮
lines.en: You hit armor plate, not hide.

lines.zh: 我这体重，撞上会压塌
lines.en: At my weight, a bump flattens things.

lines.zh: 让开，我转身要一圈地方
lines.en: Clear out; I need room to turn.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的爪尖了
lines.en: You stepped on the tip of my claw.

lines.zh: 别从下面钻，我看得见
lines.en: Don't duck underneath; I can see you.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我胃口更差
lines.en: That bump only worsened my mood for food.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，离得太近了
lines.en: I lower my head; you're much too close.

lines.zh: 地面被我踩陷了一块
lines.en: The ground caved where I put my weight.

lines.zh: 上古只剩我一个，这话我说过
lines.en: I've said it before: I'm the last of the ancients.

lines.zh: 你也饿吗，那就一起等
lines.en: Are you hungry too? Then we wait together.

lines.zh: 我允许你站在我影子边上
lines.en: I'll allow you to stand at the edge of my shadow.

lines.zh: 两副牙一起咬，猎物跑不掉
lines.en: Two sets of teeth and nothing escapes.

lines.zh: 我不认伴，只认一起吃的
lines.en: I don't take mates, only eating companions.

lines.zh: 你替我看着东边，我慢慢嚼
lines.en: You watch the east while I chew slowly.

lines.zh: 谁先吃饱，谁先睡
lines.en: Whoever eats first sleeps first.

lines.zh: 我的吼声你也学得来吗
lines.en: Can you learn to roar the way I do?

lines.zh: 我们之间不用信任，用食量
lines.en: Between us it isn't trust, it's appetite.

lines.zh: 到最后，只剩一副骨头陪着
lines.en: In the end, one skeleton keeps the other company.

lines.zh: 我把整只猎物吞下去了
lines.en: I swallowed the whole carcass in one go.

lines.zh: 这块骨头，留着磨牙
lines.en: This bone will do for grinding my teeth.

lines.zh: 食团还没吐出来，先含着
lines.en: The pellet isn't out yet; I'll hold it in.

lines.zh: 掉下来的东西，归我的胃
lines.en: Whatever falls belongs to my stomach.

lines.zh: 我叼起石头，以为是蛋
lines.en: I picked up a stone thinking it was an egg.

lines.zh: 猎物身上的东西，都算战利品
lines.en: Everything on the prey counts as spoils.

lines.zh: 这一口太小，不够塞牙
lines.en: That mouthful is too small to be worth it.

lines.zh: 我把它压进泥里，慢慢找
lines.en: I press it into the mud and search slowly.

lines.zh: 每天早上，我能吐出十个
lines.en: Every morning I can spit out ten of them.

lines.zh: 舌头上粘着毛，很不舒服
lines.en: Fur stuck to my tongue is uncomfortable.

lines.zh: 那只羊在坡上，我看见它了
lines.en: That sheep on the slope: I see it clearly.

lines.zh: 有人举着弓，那算挑衅
lines.en: Someone raised a bow; that counts as a challenge.

lines.zh: 胃口条动了，我该进食了
lines.en: The appetite bar stirred; time to feed.

lines.zh: 这头牛够我嚼一会儿
lines.en: That cow will keep me chewing a while.

lines.zh: 谁在敲我的石头，站出来
lines.en: Who's striking my rock? Step out.

lines.zh: 那个村子有味道，我记住了
lines.en: That village has a smell; I've noted it.

lines.zh: 猎物往水里跑，正合我意
lines.en: The prey runs for the water; that suits me.

lines.zh: 我锁定它了，跑不掉的
lines.en: I've locked onto it; it won't get away.

lines.zh: 那只猪撞了我，得还回去
lines.en: That pig bumped me; it needs repaying.

lines.zh: 有人在我地盘上搭了棚
lines.en: Someone built a shelter on my ground.

lines.zh: 风把羊群的味道推到我脸上
lines.en: The wind pushes the flock's scent into my face.

lines.zh: 我选最肥的那只，不吃瘦的
lines.en: I pick the fattest one; the lean ones wait.

lines.zh: 走在前面的那个，先吃
lines.en: The one in front gets eaten first.

lines.zh: 他回头看了我一眼，太迟了
lines.en: He glanced back at me; far too late.

lines.zh: 那只羊的腿在抖，就它了
lines.en: That sheep's legs are shaking. It will do.

lines.zh: 铁傀儡走起来叮当响，烦人
lines.en: The iron golem clanks. Annoying.

lines.zh: 有个影子在树后挪，我盯上了
lines.en: Something shifts behind the trees. Mine.

lines.zh: 谁的篝火灭了，那人还在睡
lines.en: Their fire died and they still sleep.

lines.zh: 我一步一步跟，不急着咬
lines.en: I follow step by step; no rush to bite.

lines.zh: 你跑得再快，也在我的圈里
lines.en: Run however fast, you're still in my circle.

lines.zh: 我吼一声，你的腿就软了
lines.en: I roar once and your legs turn weak.

lines.zh: 地面在抖，那是我要落下来
lines.en: The ground shakes; that's my foot coming down.

lines.zh: 你别往树上爬，树会断
lines.en: Don't climb the tree; it will snap.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里的声音，听过就忘不掉
lines.en: The sound in my throat is hard to forget.

lines.zh: 你躲到石头后面，我听得见
lines.en: Hide behind that rock; I still hear you.

lines.zh: 弱化与缓慢，先给你两样
lines.en: Weakness and slowness: you get both first.

lines.zh: 我每掉四分之一血，就会停
lines.en: Every quarter of my health gone, I pause.

lines.zh: 那时候你可以喂我，别错过
lines.en: That's your chance to feed me; don't miss it.

lines.zh: 我绕过去，你的退路就没了
lines.en: Once I circle around, your retreat is gone.

lines.zh: 你的箭只是给我挠痒
lines.en: Your arrows only scratch my itch.

lines.zh: 我把头压低了，这是要冲
lines.en: My head is low; this is the charge.

lines.zh: 别指望我累，我从不等
lines.en: Don't expect me to tire; I never wait.

lines.zh: 我抬起前爪，地面先裂开
lines.en: I lift a foreleg; the ground splits first.

lines.zh: 你的盾挡正面，我从侧面来
lines.en: Your shield guards the front. I come from the side.

lines.zh: 我一步一步压过去，别想绕
lines.en: I close in step by step. Do not think of circling.

lines.zh: 喘息声越来越近，是我的
lines.en: The breathing grows nearer. It is mine.

lines.zh: 你数到三，我的脚就落地
lines.en: Count to three; that is when my foot lands.

lines.zh: 我把头一甩，尘土挡住了你
lines.en: I toss my head and dust hides you.

lines.zh: 前爪落下去，地陷了两格
lines.en: My forepaw lands and the ground sinks two blocks.

lines.zh: 这一口连甲带肉
lines.en: One bite takes armor along with flesh.

lines.zh: 我的践踏不挑方向
lines.en: My stomp doesn't care which way it lands.

lines.zh: 你被震开，站都站不稳
lines.en: The shock throws you off your feet.

lines.zh: 吼声先到，牙后到
lines.en: The roar arrives before the teeth.

lines.zh: 我用肩膀顶，比牙更沉
lines.en: My shoulder shove lands heavier than my bite.

lines.zh: 这一下够了，你该倒了
lines.en: That should be enough to put you down.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫过，你滑出去很远
lines.en: My tail sweeps past and you slide far.

lines.zh: 我嚼了两下，没尝出味道
lines.en: I chewed twice and tasted nothing.

lines.zh: 你的盾挡住了牙，没挡住爪
lines.en: Your shield stopped teeth, not claws.

lines.zh: 我一巴掌拍了下去
lines.en: I brought one paw straight down.

lines.zh: 这一击是为那顿没吃到的饭
lines.en: That blow was for the meal I never got.

lines.zh: 你退了，我就不追这一步
lines.en: You backed off, so I'll hold this step.

lines.zh: 骨头裂的声音，我最喜欢
lines.en: The crack of bone is my favorite sound.

lines.zh: 我从地底上来，土还在掉
lines.en: I rise from underground, dirt still falling.

lines.zh: 胃口条亮起来，我饿了
lines.en: The appetite bar lights up; I'm hungry.

lines.zh: 这片地是空的，正好归我
lines.en: This land is empty; it suits me fine.

lines.zh: 我先吼一声，让四周安静
lines.en: I roar once to silence everything nearby.

lines.zh: 五百点生命，够打很久
lines.en: Five hundred health will last a long fight.

lines.zh: 上古的骨头在响，是醒了
lines.en: Ancient bones creak; I'm waking.

lines.zh: 我一脚踩碎了那块石板
lines.en: One step shattered that stone slab.

lines.zh: 这里的人还没见过我这种
lines.en: The people here have never seen my kind.

lines.zh: 我先找吃的，再谈地盘
lines.en: I'll find food first, then discuss territory.

lines.zh: 天亮了，我记得这个时辰
lines.en: Dawn comes; I remember this hour.

lines.zh: 四下都是小东西，太少了
lines.en: Small creatures everywhere, far too few.

lines.zh: 我站起来，影子盖住半个村
lines.en: I stand and my shadow covers half the village.

lines.zh: 这具身体饿了太久
lines.en: This body has gone hungry too long.

lines.zh: 谁先动，谁就先被吃
lines.en: Whoever moves first gets eaten first.

lines.zh: 土从裂缝里拱起来，是我
lines.en: The soil heaves out of the crack. That is me.

lines.zh: 第一声吼，把林子里的鸟赶光
lines.en: My first roar empties the trees of birds.

lines.zh: 我站起来，树梢只到我肩
lines.en: I stand; the treetops reach only my shoulder.

lines.zh: 这一片，以前也是我的地盘
lines.en: This stretch was mine once, too.

lines.zh: 饥饿先醒，我才醒
lines.en: Hunger wakes first. Then me.

lines.zh: 我踩碎的第一块石头很脆
lines.en: The first stone I crush is brittle.

lines.zh: 火在我甲缝里烧，很烫
lines.en: Fire burns in the gaps of my armor.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，砸出一个坑
lines.en: I fell from height and left a crater.

lines.zh: 水进到肺里，我咳不出来
lines.en: Water fills my lungs and I can't cough.

lines.zh: 炸药的味，比肉香差远了
lines.en: Explosive smoke smells nothing like meat.

lines.zh: 一支箭卡在甲片下面
lines.en: An arrow wedged under one of my plates.

lines.zh: 药水让我胃里翻了一下
lines.en: That potion turned my stomach over once.

lines.zh: 饿到骨头都在响
lines.en: Hungry enough that my bones creak.

lines.zh: 雷劈在背上，毛全立起来
lines.en: Lightning struck my back and my hair stood up.

lines.zh: 我在往下掉，抓不到任何东西
lines.en: I'm falling with nothing left to grab.
